ccdcfc8af8f82a2ee0476ea9bbdd4f32a6885538.text: 他笑着说自己的功劳不足挂齿。

ccdfc594753abb2c0484369276c6f4a538dbc202.pinyin: shī zhōng de nǚ zǐ zī tài chán yuán.

cce4b04354fa226bc7ec7646ccd9d9b8dd0208cd.pinyin: zhè liǎng gè chōng diàn qì bù néng hùn yòng.
cce4b04354fa226bc7ec7646ccd9d9b8dd0208cd.text: 这两个充电器不能混用。

cce4fa7c0509aa9de67f1cb205a92b8f3501f769.pinyin: tā bǎ qián bāo fàng jìn le kǒu dài.

cce749e04ed1b963975bda54056fe677532c4b01.pinyin: tā shì yí wèi xián jìng de gū niang.

cce7700a96c6cc3323a4a86d33d2623ffafc2266.pinyin: shān pō shàng zhǎng zhe yī kē huáng bò.

cce863c2f666f667676c8a7310d74ff80d382ac2.pinyin: zhuō shàng yǒu yì xiǎo dié xián cài.

ccea1140dff7fb2e622352da05b6568d91a26e97.pinyin: tuì kuǎn shí xū yào chū shì gòu mǎi píng zhèng.
ccea1140dff7fb2e622352da05b6568d91a26e97.text: 退款时需要出示购买凭证。

ccea51814e0321cdec244aa73d50b5ebb5ccbb23.pinyin: dà jiā qī shǒu bā jiǎo de bān kāi shí tou.
ccea51814e0321cdec244aa73d50b5ebb5ccbb23.text: 大家七手八脚地搬开石头。

ccecedfbbb24f1ad1234c05fc20bc786e151b4ff.pinyin: tā de wēi xié zhǐ shì wài qiáng zhōng gān.
ccecedfbbb24f1ad1234c05fc20bc786e151b4ff.text: 他的威胁只是外强中干。

ccef731de3ee70f99471ca5e819b02f2cd591db0.pinyin: nǐ zhī dào dōng jīng tiě tǎ zài nǎ lǐ ma?
ccef731de3ee70f99471ca5e819b02f2cd591db0.text: 你知道东京铁塔在哪里吗？

ccf065d7d91b14a7c4b9f13dab0f73d2a2f7a7f1.pinyin: zhè cì hé zuò ràng tā men bīng shì qián xián.
ccf065d7d91b14a7c4b9f13dab0f73d2a2f7a7f1.text: 这次合作让他们冰释前嫌。

ccf6eae97499ac8adae3ac573594420b64a707d1.pinyin: jūn wù kǒng zǒng, tā hěn shǎo yǒu kòng huí jiā.
ccf6eae97499ac8adae3ac573594420b64a707d1.text: 军务倥偬，他很少有空回家。

ccf8dbcd88a5e25e66a04aa5c298373aa99e22d4.pinyin: tā bǎ tāng fàng zài guō lǐ jiā rè.

ccfb357b14042e9189eede3bd50a9e82760de4d4.pinyin: tāng mǔ dāng shang le bù zhǎng.

ccfbd669e4760f45881de78e155d5696cad86886.pinyin: cāng kù chǔ bèi le zú gòu de liáng shi.
ccfbd669e4760f45881de78e155d5696cad86886.text: 仓库储备了足够的粮食。

ccfbf277ecdeca0a3f6afea773cf4db921dbe600.pinyin: tā yīn shòu dào shàng jí chǒng xìn ér zhì shǒu kě rè, bié rén dōu bù gǎn dé zuì tā.
ccfbf277ecdeca0a3f6afea773cf4db921dbe600.text: 他因受到上级宠信而炙手可热，别人都不敢得罪他。

ccfdfbdee0fd51d538644ce973d6e3e7025c198b.pinyin: xīn bàn fǎ de chéng xiào hái xū yào guān chá.
ccfdfbdee0fd51d538644ce973d6e3e7025c198b.text: 新办法的成效还需要观察。
